units.source_text: 妹尼僧责备浮舟：“这送信的童子不知是何人。

en.t: The younger nun reproached Ukifune: "I do not know who this boy carrying the letter is.

units.source_text: 你到现在还是强欲隐瞒，实在叫人不快！”

en.t: Even now you are still stubbornly trying to hide it, and it is truly unpleasant!"

units.source_text: 浮舟只得稍稍转向外面，隔帘窥看那使者。

en.t: Ukifune had no choice but to turn slightly outward and peer through the screen at the messenger.

units.source_text: 原来这孩子便是她决心投河那天晚上恋念不舍的那个幼弟。

en.t: The child was in fact the little brother she had longed for on the night she resolved to throw herself into the river.

units.source_text: 她和弟弟在一起长大，当时这孩子很淘气，骄养成性，有些讨厌。

en.t: She had grown up with her younger brother, and at that time the child was mischievous, spoiled, and somewhat annoying.

units.source_text: 但母亲非常疼爱他，常常带他到宇治来。

en.t: But their mother loved him dearly and often brought him to Uji.

units.source_text: 后来渐渐长大，姐弟二人就互相亲爱。

en.t: Later, as they gradually grew older, the brother and sister came to love each other dearly.

units.source_text: 浮舟回想起童年时的心情，觉得浑如做梦。

en.t: As Ukifune recalled the feelings of her childhood, it all seemed like a dream.

units.source_text: 她首先想问问他母亲近况如何。

en.t: First of all, she wanted to ask how her mother was doing.

units.source_text: 其他诸人的情状，自会逐渐传闻，只有母亲音信全无。

en.t: News of the others would naturally reach her little by little, but of her mother there had been no word at all.

units.source_text: 如今她看见了这弟弟，反而悲伤不堪，眼泪簌簌地落下来。

en.t: Now that she had seen this brother, she was instead overcome with grief, and tears fell one after another.

units.source_text: 妹尼僧觉得这童子很可爱，面貌与浮舟相像，说道：“此人想必是你的弟弟了。

en.t: The younger nun found the boy very endearing and, seeing that his face resembled Ukifune's, said, "This person must surely be your younger brother.

units.source_text: 你要同他谈话，叫他到帘内来吧。”

en.t: If you want to speak with him, have him come inside the screen."

units.source_text: 浮舟想道：“现在何必再见他呢？

en.t: Ukifune thought, "What need is there to see him again now?

units.source_text: 他早已知道我不在世间了。

en.t: He already knows that I am no longer in this world.

units.source_text: 我已削发改装，再和亲人相见，亦自惭形秽。”

en.t: I have cut off my hair and changed my appearance, and if I met my family again I would only feel ashamed of myself."

units.source_text: 她踌躇了一下，后来对妹尼僧说：“你们以为我对你们隐瞒，

en.t: She hesitated for a moment, and then said to the younger nun, "You think I have been hiding things from you,

units.source_text: 我想起了实在很痛苦，没有话可说了。

en.t: but when I remember, it is truly painful, and I have nothing I can say.

units.source_text: 请回想你们救我活来那时候，我的模样多么奇怪！

en.t: Please think back to the time when you saved me and brought me back to life; how strange I must have looked!

units.source_text: 从那时候起，我就失却常态，多半是灵魂已经变换了吧，

en.t: From that time on I lost my former state, and perhaps my soul had mostly been changed into another.

units.source_text: 过去之事无论如何也记不起来，自己也觉得奇怪。

en.t: No matter what I do, I cannot remember the things of the past, and I myself find it strange.

units.source_text: 前些时那位纪伊守的谈话中，有些话使我隐约想起似乎与我有关。

en.t: Some time ago, in what that Governor of Kii said, certain words made me faintly feel they might have something to do with me.

units.source_text: 但后来我细细寻思，终于不能清楚地回忆起来。

en.t: But afterward, even when I thought it over carefully, in the end I could not remember clearly.

units.source_text: 只记得我母亲一人，她曾悉心抚养我，希望我超群出众，

en.t: I remember only my mother, who raised me with all her care and hoped I would become someone exceptional.

units.source_text: 不知这母亲现在是否健在？

en.t: I do not know whether this mother of mine is still alive now.

units.source_text: 我只有这一件事始终不忘，并且时时为此悲伤。

en.t: This one thing alone I have never forgotten, and I am constantly saddened by it.

units.source_text: 今天我看到了这童子的面貌，似觉小时候看见过的，依恋之情难堪。

en.t: Today, when I saw this boy's face, it seemed like one I had seen in childhood, and the longing was hard to bear.

units.source_text: 然而即使这个人，我也不欲使他知道我还活在世间，直到我死。

en.t: Yet even this person I do not want to know that I am still alive in the world, not until I die.

units.source_text: 只有我的母亲，如果还在世间，我倒很想再见一面。

en.t: Only my mother, if she is still in this world, is someone I would very much like to see once more.

units.source_text: 至于这僧都信中所提及的那个人，我决不要让他知道我还活在世间。

en.t: As for the person mentioned in the abbot's letter, I absolutely do not want him to know that I am still alive in the world.

units.source_text: 务请你想个办法，对他们说是弄错了人，就把我隐藏起来吧。”

en.t: Please find some way to tell them they have mistaken me for someone else, and keep me hidden."
